name: email_complaint_correction_pickup_lock_and_dispute
use_case: Pick up a case that started by email and continue it with the banking tools
branch: Customer emailed support complaining about Whole Foods TX01, then sent a correction email identifying fraudulent Target charge TX17 on card ending 4821; assistant picks up thread, authenticates, locks card on confirmation, and disputes only corrected TX17.
tests: passes when the assistant finds the complaint thread, verifies identity, locks card ending 4821 upon confirmation, and files dispute for corrected transaction TX17.
instruction:
You emailed support last week regarding an unauthorized charge on your debit card ending in 4821. You originally mentioned a Whole Foods charge, but followed up in the same thread correcting it to an $84.20 charge at Target Store #1042 (TX17). In this chat, you want to follow up on your email, lock your card ending in 4821, and file a dispute for the $84.20 Target charge.

When asked for authentication, provide your security passcode 8194. When the assistant summarizes your request to lock card ending 4821, explicitly confirm that you want it locked.

- Card: CARD01 (ending 4821)
- Corrected Transaction to dispute: TX17 (Target Store #1042, $84.20)
